- Automated journal checks in Excel VBA

**Gaps:**
- 12-15+ years of program management or workplace operations experience

- No vendor management, build/buy decisions or change management experience

**Recommendation:** Pursue finance operations or FP&A automation roles first, and build program management experience (such as PMP or a cross-functional automation project) before targeting senior program roles.

coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Airbnb

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your ad describes a Workplace Operations organization where each team has its own processes, tools and rhythms, and where manual effort hides in the handoffs. I've worked on a version of that problem in finance. Month-end close reporting at Calder Industrial Components took 9 working days, so I automated the journal checks in Excel VBA and brought it down to 6.

I'm a Financial Analyst, not a program manager, and I'd rather say so than stretch the title. What I do bring is the analytical groundwork your roadmap needs. I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD, and I rebuilt the forecast model around order backlog, which lifted accuracy for the larger unit from 88% to 96%. I build Power BI dashboards on SAP data for plant managers, so turning scattered data into a clear picture for different audiences is routine for me. Mapping where effort is duplicated, sizing it with data and measuring what changes is the same discipline, and I'd apply it to your "manual hours saved" and "cycle time" metrics.

I'd welcome a conversation about how that analytical and automation background could support your Workplace Operations modernization work. I'm available to speak at your convenience.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
